The Honors College

The Honors College at Example State offers small seminars of no more than 15 students, taught by full-time faculty.

Honors students live together in Founders Hall during their first year and receive priority registration.

Every honors student completes a senior thesis with a faculty mentor.

Honors courses count toward every major, and most students take one or two each semester alongside their regular classes.

Applications open in the fall for current first-year students, and incoming students are invited based on their admission file.
